members: public R2dbcTelemetryRecordRepository(DatabaseClient client, AesGcmPayloadCipher cipher) { this.client = client; this.cipher = cipher; }

private static String sha256Hex(String value) { try { return HexFormat.of().formatHex(MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(value.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))); } catch (NoSuchAlgorithmException e) { throw new IllegalStateException("digest unavailable"); } }
private static OffsetDateTime utc(Instant instant) { return OffsetDateTime.ofInstant(instant, ZoneOffset.UTC); }

private static boolean isUniqueViolation(Throwable error) { for (Throwable t = error; t != null; t = t.getCause()) { if (t instanceof R2dbcException r && "23505".equals(r.getSqlState())) { return true; } } return false; }

private Mono<Void> insertRevision(Long recordId, int revisionNumber, double value, String reason) { return client.sql("INSERT INTO telemetry_revisions (record_id, revision_number, sample_value, reason, created_at) VALUES (:recordId, :revisionNumber, :value, :reason, :createdAt)").bind("recordId", recordId).bind("revisionNumber", revisionNumber).bind("value", value).bind("reason", reason).bind("createdAt", OffsetDateTime.now(ZoneOffset.UTC)).fetch().rowsUpdated().then(); }

@Override public Mono<Void> appendRevision(TelemetryRevision revision) { return client.sql("SELECT record_id FROM telemetry_records WHERE device_id = :deviceId AND metric = :metric AND t_device = :tDevice ORDER BY record_id DESC LIMIT 1").bind("deviceId", revision.deviceId()).bind("metric", revision.metric()).bind("tDevice", utc(revision.tDevice())).map(row -> row.get(0, Long.class)).one().switchIfEmpty(Mono.error(new IllegalStateException("unknown record identity"))).flatMap(recordId -> insertRevision(recordId, revision.revisionNumber(), revision.value(), revision.reason())); }

@Override public Mono<TelemetryRevision> findLatestRevision(String deviceId, String metric, Instant tDevice) { return client.sql("SELECT r.revision_number, r.sample_value, r.reason FROM telemetry_revisions r JOIN telemetry_records t ON t.record_id = r.record_id WHERE t.device_id = :deviceId AND t.metric = :metric AND t.t_device = :tDevice ORDER BY r.revision_number DESC LIMIT 1").bind("deviceId", deviceId).bind("metric", metric).bind("tDevice", utc(tDevice)).map(row -> new TelemetryRevision(deviceId, metric, tDevice, row.get(0, Integer.class), row.get(1, Double.class), row.get(2, String.class))).one(); }
